text:
I rose as far as dream. I was going

        in search...



        "Life is a wounded deer

        to which arrows give wings."

        Góngora


I rose as far as dream. I was going in search

of not feeling the wound

        that burned.

The hard arrows of pain made

bloom in me the

        carnation of a new wound.


Running a race alongside the wind

and pursued by a lover's

        flame,

life is a wounded deer beyond remedy,

for the arrows give it

        poison and wings.

translation.title: I Rose as Far as Dream. I Was Going in Search...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps this longer variant's epigraph and staggered spacing while following the wound-and-wings image.
